bioconda.name: ultra_bioinformatics
bioconda.summary: Splice alignment of long transcriptomic reads to a genome, guided by exon annotations
bioconda.description: uLTRA is a tool for splice alignment of long transcriptomic reads to a genome, guided by a database of exon annotations. It is particularly accurate when aligning to small exons. As of 0.3.0 uLTRA is implemented in Rust; the command line and output files are unchanged.
